title: CSP for static sites with meta tags and hashes
when: A static site or single page app is hosted without server code and needs a Content-Security-Policy through a meta tag or the host headers file, including inline scripts that cannot move.
inputs: whether the host supports a headers file
prompt:
Goal: Every HTML page carries a working policy as early as possible, with hashes for any unavoidable inline script and no unsafe-inline.
Steps:
1. Place <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="..."> right after <meta charset> at the top of <head>; nothing before it is covered.
2. Base: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'.
3. An inline script that must stay (theme before paint) gets a hash: "sha256-" + createHash("sha256").update(text).digest("base64") in script-src.
4. scripts/csp-hashes.mjs reads each .html, hashes inline scripts and rewrites the meta tag, so edits never break it.
5. Meta ignores frame-ancestors, report-uri and sandbox; if the host reads a headers file (such as _headers), send the policy there too with frame-ancestors 'none'.
6. A page with extra needs (a map tile server) gets its own policy, not a looser shared one.
Quality bar:
- Every .html page has the tag.
- No unsafe-inline or unsafe-eval.
- Each page loads with zero console violations.
Pitfalls:
- A tag placed after scripts that already ran.
- Hashing text whose whitespace or line endings differ from the file.
- Expecting the meta tag to stop clickjacking.
Verify:
- [ ] The tag comes first in head on every page.
- [ ] Hashes regenerate from the scripts.
- [ ] The headers file adds frame-ancestors when supported.
- [ ] No unsafe keywords.
Output: Updated *.html files, scripts/csp-hashes.mjs, optional _headers file.

examples.input: meu site estatico precisa de CSP mas tem um script inline de tema
examples.output: meta CSP first in head, sha256 hash for the theme script, hash generator script, _headers with frame-ancestors
